name: Stack-Based Representation (SBR)
definition: Decomposition of a voxel grid V (resolution w × h × d) into a set S of vertical stacks, where each stack Sx,y represents the column of voxels at position xy.
summary: Stack-Based Representation compresses voxel grids into vertical stacks using run-length encoding, exploiting vertical coherence to efficiently handle layered volumetric data.
